clue.text: Takes steps in the book

definitions.meaning: first meaning: does something, takes action
second meaning: a book of the New Testament

explanation.surface: Someone carefully following the procedure laid out in a manual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The book' is the Bible, and one of its books carries this name.
explanation.definitionFit: To act is to take action, and Acts is the New Testament book recording the apostles' deeds.

clue.text: Woman stiff with cold

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female

explanation.surface: A woman frozen stiff in icy weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Frigid means very cold, as in frigid air or a frigid manner.

clue.text: Physicist most rare, no mistake …

indicators.note: a mistake puts things in the wrong order, so these letters are muddled

explanation.surface: A rare scientist who never errs, with the ellipsis carrying the sentence into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The trailing dots link the surface to 4 down; each clue is solved alone.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronomer studies celestial bodies, a branch of physics, so the example fits the broader word.

clue.text: … is occupied by sage creating pictures

indicators.note: something occupied has something else living inside it, so the outer word holds the other

parts.note: a mage is a wise man or magician

explanation.surface: Continuing 3 down: a seer moves in and starts painting.
explanation.walkthrough: A mage is an archaic word for a magician or wise man, a fair match for sage.
explanation.definitionFit: Images are pictures or visual representations.

clue.text: Mixed up fool or Lawrence died

parts.note: T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia
d. is the abbreviation for died

explanation.surface: Someone confused about whether a fool or Lawrence passed away.
explanation.walkthrough: T. E. Lawrence was the British officer known as Lawrence of Arabia.
explanation.definitionFit: Assorted things are of various kinds put together, jumbled up rather than sorted.

clue.text: Clever chaps brought three gifts

definitions.meaning: surface reading: some bright men being generous
setter's reading: the wise men of the Nativity, who brought gold, frankincense and myrrh

explanation.surface: Some smart fellows turning up with presents.
explanation.definitionFit: The wise men from the East in Matthew's gospel are traditionally three, bearing three gifts to the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Silver debris's glowing

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Fragments of silver lying about and shining.
explanation.definitionFit: Aglitter means sparkling or shining brightly, a close match for glowing.

clue.text: Good news for good boy with titanium rings

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good, followed by a lad, a boy
Ti is the chemical symbol for titanium
a ding is the ringing sound of a bell

explanation.surface: A well-behaved boy is given titanium rings, which is welcome news.
explanation.definitionFit: Glad tidings is an old phrase for good news, from the Christmas angel's message.

clue.text: Smith's car involved in festival

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are knotted into a new order

explanation.surface: Mr Smith's car taking part in a festival parade.
explanation.definitionFit: Christmas is the Christian festival celebrating the birth of Jesus.

clue.text: Sponsor article on member's setback

indicators.note: a setback sends things backwards, so the word for member is read in reverse

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A backer writes about a club member's misfortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' means a limb here, not someone in a club.
explanation.definitionFit: An angel is an investor who backs a theatrical production or new business, a sponsor.

clue.text: New guard's daughter ignored sweetener

indicators.note: something new is made afresh, so the remaining letters are rearranged
what is ignored is left out, so that letter drops away

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A recruit guard whose daughter declined the sugar in her tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is the commonest sweetening substance in food and drink.

clue.text: Would have exulted, if inside, having been honoured

indicators.note: inside says one piece sits within the other

parts.note: to glory is to exult; the 'would have' is surface padding for the past tense

explanation.surface: Someone who would have rejoiced, had they been given an honour.
explanation.walkthrough: To glory in something is to exult over it; 'would have' merely dresses up the past tense for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To glorify is to praise and exalt, so the glorified have been honoured.

clue.text: See 8
The French bill American first for furniture

indicators.note: first places the following word before the other in the build

parts.note: in the US a tab is the bill in a bar or restaurant

explanation.surface: A French invoice, with the American bill paid first, for some furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top on legs.

clue.text: Birdsong of the network

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the chirping sound of birds
second meaning: the social media network

explanation.surface: Bird calls heard across some network.
explanation.definitionFit: A twitter is the chirruping noise birds make, and Twitter was the name of the social media platform.

clue.text: Thankless person covering inbuilt, active tendency initially to toady

indicators.note: covering means wrapping around, so the person surrounds the small letters

parts.note: an ingrate is an ungrateful person

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: An ungrateful person hiding a built-in, active urge to fawn.
explanation.walkthrough: The three initials go in just before the final letter of the thankless person.
explanation.definitionFit: To ingratiate oneself is to curry favour by flattery, just as a toady does.

clue.text: Two pounds taken from elderly criminal with piping voice

indicators.note: criminal means crooked, so the remaining letters are bent into a new order
taken from means removed, so those letters come out

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound, twice

explanation.surface: An old crook with a thin voice relieved of two pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A reedy voice is thin and high, like the sound of a reed pipe.

clue.text: Liberal in profitable times may flourish

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a boom is a period of economic prosperity
L is the abbreviation for Liberal

explanation.surface: Liberal politics may thrive when the economy is good.
explanation.definitionFit: To bloom is to flower, and by extension to thrive or flourish.

clue.text: Journalist promoted, protected by new suitor — a stranger

indicators.note: in a down clue promoted means moved upwards, so the word reads bottom to top
something protected is shielded on all sides, so it sits inside the other piece
new means made over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaperman gets promoted, shielded by a new admirer, who is a stranger.
explanation.definitionFit: An outsider is a person who does not belong to a group, a stranger to it.

clue.text: Get together on a short day

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the abbreviation for Wednesday

explanation.surface: Meeting up on a day with little daylight.
explanation.definitionFit: To wed is to marry, joining two people together, and Wed is the standard abbreviation of a weekday.

clue.text: Tell Wood about the affluent!

definitions.note: the well-to-do, used as a noun for wealthy people

indicators.note: about means around in different directions, so the letters are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: An order to inform someone called Wood about the rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-to-do means wealthy and comfortably off.

clue.text: Greek capital — ergo different canyon

indicators.note: a capital is the letter at the head of a word
different means changed, so these letters take another order

explanation.surface: A logician's 'ergo' about the capital of Greece, Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek capital' looks like a call for Athens, but it is the first letter of Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: A gorge is a narrow steep-sided valley, a synonym for canyon.

clue.text: Transport for hospital department that originally had recommended a laryngectomy

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Arranging a lift for the throat department that advised removing a voice box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' is a verb meaning to delight, not a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To enthral is to captivate, the same sense as transport with delight.

clue.text: Though wary, take it in, love!

indicators.note: take ... in means to admit inside, so one word holds the other

explanation.surface: A cautious lover is told to accept something anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take it in' splits round its middle word: the indicator wraps the very piece it places.
explanation.definitionFit: Charity in the old Bible sense means Christian love, as in 'faith, hope and charity'.

clue.text: Light cigar

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the ring of light around the sun or moon
second meaning: a long straight-sided cigar

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as an instruction to light a cigar; each word is a separate definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A corona is a halo of light around a celestial body, and also a type of cigar.

clue.text: Frozen drip put in charge twice by the French

parts.note: IC is short for in charge, written twice

explanation.surface: A frozen leak where a Frenchman was put in command twice over.
explanation.definitionFit: An icicle is a hanging spike of ice formed by dripping water freezing.

clue.text: Come in following heroic work on the midpoint of geological disturbance in the US

definitions.text: the midpoint of geological disturbance in the US

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the first word placed comes second in the build

parts.note: an epic is a heroic poem
to enter is to come in

explanation.surface: Arriving after an epic poem about an American earthquake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the US' flags the American spelling ending -ER.
explanation.definitionFit: The epicentre is the point on the surface directly above an earthquake's origin.

clue.text: Flair displayed in melancholy themes

indicators.note: displayed in says the letters are on show within the words that follow

parts.note: letters two to five of the first word

explanation.surface: Talent shown in gloomy subject matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is style and dash, a near synonym of flair.

clue.text: Teas drunk at this point

definitions.note: the answer names a compass point; 'this' points at the clue's own answer

indicators.note: someone drunk staggers about, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Tea being drunk at a certain moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Point' means a compass point, not a moment in time.
explanation.definitionFit: East is one of the four cardinal compass points.

clue.text: Kicking out two thousand that were topping

indicators.note: out means removed, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for a thousand, twice

explanation.surface: Ejecting two thousand people who were on top.
explanation.definitionFit: Icing is the sugar coating spread on top of a cake.

clue.text: For a change, log-bearing, delivering warmth

indicators.note: a change means an alteration, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Carrying logs to the fire to keep warm.
explanation.definitionFit: A glow is a feeling of warmth, as in the glow of a fire.

clue.text: Maintains saver, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters may be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Someone keeps up a savings account, possibly.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to assert or maintain that something is true.

clue.text: Give two pounds with love to sculptor

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound, twice
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: Sending a sculptor a couple of pounds with a loving note.
explanation.definitionFit: Donatello was the Florentine Renaissance sculptor, famous for his bronze David.
